geeklist.title: Year end 2025 Auction
geeklist.description: Auction rules 1. The Auction will end sometime at night E.T. on 12/10/2025 2. Please place bids in $1 increments unless special rule is listed in certain item. 3. PayPal/Venmo/Zelle payment . 4. BGG gets 3% through the BGG marketplace. 5. I will only ship to the U.S. Please ask me for quote if you have concerns. Combined shipping will be provided. Buyer pays shipping from 28277. I will use pirateship to get the best price. Local pick up also available. 6.Start bid(SB) provided. Don't bid under SB in comments. Buy it now (BIN) is also provided. 7.I have the right to add or remove items if no one BINed. 8.Pet free, smoke free. If you have concerns about game condition, ask me first. I would try my best to answer that. 9.Please bid with your zip, this will help me estimate shipping cost and save our time.
